gaps.explanation: Re-read pp5, 10-17. Net 978,735 = gap. Two printed bases; no missing or duplicate line.

Per fund, GAAP p5 vs budgetary actual: General 25,861,646 vs 25,865,678 (p10); City Highway Allocation 13,808,024 vs 12,423,552 (p11); American Rescue Plan 259,109 vs 258,136 (p11); Debt Service 972,400 vs 972,401 (p17); Special Assessments 291,221 vs 570,091 (p16); Capital Construction 5,316,888 vs 5,989,148 (p16); Other Governmental Funds 7,153,763 vs pp13-15 104,985 + 513,505 + 38,168 + 149,726 + 47,433 + 303,129 + 414,411 + 1,443,120 = 3,014,477 + CDA 4,140,596 (p12) = 7,155,073. Net 428,972 = gap. Budgetary vs GAAP; no missing or duplicate line.

Statement p5 Issuance of Debt 1,965,000 (Special Assessments column only); JSON debt_proceeds 1,965,000 + other_financing 134,438 (Premium on Bonds 37,221 + Information Technology Subscriptions 48,529 + Insurance Proceeds 48,688) = 2,099,438. Detail non-transfer other-financing lines: Special Assessments budgetary schedule p16 Proceeds from Debt Financing 3,730,000 and Discount on Debt (18,090) = 3,711,910; plus General Information Technology Subscriptions 48,529 added below = 3,760,439. Remaining difference 1,661,001 = budgetary Special Assessments debt rows 3,711,910 (p16) vs GAAP Special Assessments rows Issuance 1,965,000 + Premium 37,221 (p5) = 2,002,221 (1,709,689), less the General Insurance Proceeds 48,688 (see below). Not added: SA Premium on Bonds 37,221 (the same fund's budgetary schedule records the debt as 3,730,000 with a discount (18,090); adding the GAAP premium would mix two printed views of the same issuance) and General Insurance Proceeds 48,688 (the General budgetary schedule p10 prints no insurance row and its Miscellaneous 249,435 exceeds GAAP Miscellaneous 174,512 by 74,923, so the proceeds are likely already inside that detail line). Printed basis difference; no forced tie.

Statement p5 General column prints 'Information Technology Subscriptions' 48,529 under Other Financing Sources (Uses); not in detail and in no existing detail line (GAAP subscription recognition; the General budgetary schedule p10 prints only Transfers In 415,000 / Transfers Out (2,772,446), both in detail).
